new_terms.definition: The copy of Google iotools 1.5 in `bin/iotools-1.5`. It is a command-line tool that reads and writes hardware registers. No TRON build file builds it.
A log line that starts with `::`, for example `::error` or `::group::`. The GitHub Actions runner acts on such a line.
The URL of one GitHub Actions workflow run. Its form is `<server>/<repository>/actions/runs/<run id>`.
The CI store of pinned Hugging Face model snapshots. `bin/ci/prime_hf_models.py` fills it. `bin/ci/hf_cache.py` keeps its ledger and journal.
The files `bin/ci/prime_hf_models.py` and `bin/ci/hf_cache.py`. `hf_cache.py` compares them between two commits before it changes the model versions of `main`.
The module `bin/ci/hf_cache.py`. It keeps the ledger and the journal of the model cache.
The script `bin/ci/prime_hf_models.py`. It downloads the pinned Hugging Face model snapshots into the model cache.
The workflow `.github/workflows/bench-refresh.yml`. It measures test costs for Slice and updates `config/test-benchmarks.json` through a pull request.
The script `bin/ci/bench-refresh-ci.sh`. It holds the sub-commands that the cost-data refresh workflows run.
The script `bin/ci/bench_refresh.py`. It applies the cost-data refresh of one platform to the JSON file and writes the refresh summary.
The script `bin/ci/bench_refresh_health.py`. It checks that the cost-data refresh of every platform still runs.
The script `bin/ci/bench_refresh_runtime.py`. It selects the test runtime that the workflow `gcp-nix.yml` built for the refresh commit.
The script `bin/ci/bench_refresh_bitfile.py`. It probes and validates the bitfile of every FPGA card on a refresh runner.
The script `bin/ci/background-check.sh`. It starts a slow check in the background of a CI job and reports the result in a later step.
The script `bin/ci/run-lint-checks.sh`. It builds the Nix lint check and reports the diagnostics in GitHub Actions.
The script `bin/ci/resolve-apt-channel.sh`. It selects the apt channel (`unstable` or `testing`) for the workflow `publish-deb.yml`.
The script `bin/ci/tron-build/prepare_handoff.py`. It describes the built TRON runtimes and decides if the workflow attempt needs the tests.
The script `bin/ci/nix-cache/publish_regional.py`. It queues one build artifact for publication to the regional Nix cache.
The script `bin/ci/ci-nix-path.sh`. It adds the install directory of `nix` to `GITHUB_PATH` when `nix` is not on `PATH`.
The script `ingest/build-all.sh`. It runs `ingest/build-model.py` for every ingest model of the model registry `config/models.yaml`.
The script `packaging/tron-host/build-deb.sh`. It packs the Debian package `tron-host`, which holds the CPU-only rinzler build `rinzler_host`.
The Nix build in `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix`. It builds TRON with CMake and produces the test runtime and the benchmark runtime for CI.
A Nix check in `flake.nix`. It configures the TRON CMake project inside the Nix sandbox.
A GHC runtime thread that runs Haskell code. The GHC option `-N<n>` sets the count.

notes: No row is dropped. Source code was opened for all 24 names. tron_use: a row says `reads` when only test files set the name. The row names those tests in `notes`. CXX, DESTDIR and GH_TOKEN say `reads and sets`: Nix files, a packaging script or workflows set them. GH_TOKEN is defined by the GitHub CLI. It is in the group `github-actions`, as only CI workflows and CI scripts use it. DEBIAN_FRONTEND is in the group `other`. FETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED stays a row. A Nix build phase exports it. Nothing in the checkout reads the environment form. GHCRTS: no TRON source line reads it. The row says `reads`, as the GHC runtime inside the TRON programs `ingest` and `ingest-tests` reads it. CROSS_COMPILE and EXTRA_CFLAGS belong to the vendored iotools makefile. No TRON build file runs that makefile. CXX: the two workflows set `/usr/bin/clang++-19`, and no TRON script reads that value. The CMake preset `base-ninja` sets the compiler itself. GITHUB_SERVER_URL: the input said that the `cache_context` log line has a `run_url` field. The code names that field `workflow_url` (`bin/ci/prime_hf_models.py`). The row does not name the field. GITHUB_REPOSITORY: the sub-command `derive-publication` also reaches the check `GITHUB_REPOSITORY is required`, as it calls `apply_refresh`. The row does not count the sub-commands. GITHUB_OUTPUT: `bench_refresh_health.py` and `prepare_handoff.py` test for `None`, so an empty value is used as a path. The 25-word limit of `default` left no room, so this is in `notes`. GITHUB_ENV: the sentence that later steps get `NAME` describes GitHub Actions. The checkout comment in `.github/workflows/cmake-single-platform.yml` says the same. Script names such as `hf_cache.py` and `bench-refresh-ci.sh` are defined in `new_terms`, not in every cell, to keep the word limits. Evidence quotes are the source lines without leading spaces. One line is longer than 120 characters: `CMakeLists.txt:227` (155 characters). Its quote is the first 120 characters.
